content: Sunaama Maccasiw
Elsi, hayqida I na7aa pathida maccasiw, “Ne soo asaa ekada haysafe bada neeni danda7iya bessan awunka de7a. Goday laapun laytha koshaa ha biitta bolla yeddis” yaagis.
Maccasiya Elsi odidaysada ba soo asaara bada, Filisxeeme biittan laapun laythi de7asu.
Laapuntha laytha wursethan maccasiya Filisxeeme biittafe simmasu. Ba keethaanne ba gadiya oychanaw kawako basu.
He wode kawoy Xoossaa asi gidida Elsa aylliya Giyaazara odetishe, “Elsi oothida gita ooso ubbaa ane taw oda” yaagis.

Elsi hayqida na7aa waatidi pathidaako, Giyaazi kawas odishin, Heko, Elsi I na7aa pathida maccasiya ba keethaanne ba gadiya oychanaw yasu. Giyaazi, “Ta godaw, kawaw, maccasiya hannashu; Elsi hayqope pathida I na7ayka haysish” yaagis.
Kawoy maccasiw oychin, iyaw odasu. Hessa gisho, kawoy halaqaa xeegidi, “Ha maccaseeba gidida ubbaanne iya agga bida wodiyape hachi gakanaw I gaden mokida ubbaa iw zaara” yaagidi kiittis.
Elsi Damasqo katama bidi gakiya wode, Soore kawoy Wolde-Adari saketees. I, “Xoossaa asi haysa yis” giya wore si7is.
Kawoy Azaheelako, “Immiyaba ekada Xoossa addiyara gahetanaw bada, ‘Taani ha hargiyafe paxanee?’ yaagada Godaa oycha” yaagis.

Hessa gisho, Azaheeli Damasqon de7iya dumma dumma qommo muruutape oytamu gimalen caanidi, Elsara gahetanaw bis. Elsa sinthan eqidi, “Ne na7ay Araame kawoy Wolde-Adari, ‘Taani ha hargiyafe paxanee?’ yaagidi, nena oychanaada tana neeko kiittis” yaagis.
Elsi Azaheelako, “Neeni bada iyako, ‘Tuma neeni paxana’ yaaga. Shin I tuma hayqanaysa tana Goday bessis” yaagis.
Azaheeli yeellatana gakanaw, Elsi iya tishshi oothidi xeellidi yeekis.

Yaatin, Azaheeli, “Ta goday ayis yeekii?” yaagidi oychis. Elsi, “Neeni Isra7eele asa bolla oothana iitabaa taani eriya gisho yeekayis. Enta miixaa neeni taman xuuggana; enta panthata neeni mashshan wodhana. Qassi enta yooga naytaka neeni shuchan mentherethana; enta qantha maccasata uluwa neeni daakana” yaagidi zaaris.
Azaheeli zaaridi, “Taani ne aylley, pathenna kanay, haysa mela gitaba waatada oothanaw danda7iyana?” yaagis. Elsi zaaridi, “Neeni Araame biittan kawotanaysa tana Goday bessis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Azaheeli Elsafe shaaketidi, ba godaako simmis. Wolde-Adari, “Elsi nena woygidee?” yaagidi oychis. Azaheeli, “Neeni tuma paxana” yaagis.
Shin wontetha gallas Azaheeli bulluko ekidi, haathan muukidi, kawa iyara tuccin, kawoy hayqis. Azaheeli iya bessan baw kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Iyoraama
Akaaba na7ay, Isra7eele kawoy Iyoraami kawotida ichashantho laythan, Yihuda Kawa Iyosaafexa na7ay Iyoraami Yihudan kawotis.
Iyoraami kawotiya wode iyaw laythay hastamanne nam7a; I Yerusalaamen hospun laythi kawotis.
Iyoraami Akaaba na7iw macho ekida gisho, Akaaba soo asay hemetidaysada kase Isra7eele kawota ogiyan hemetis; Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
Gidoshin, ba aylliya Dawita gisho, Goday Yihuda dhaysanaw koybeenna; Dawita kochay merinaw kawotanaw de7eysa Goday ufaysa qaala immis.
Iyoraami kawotida wode, Edoome asay Yihuda kawa bolla makallidi, bantaw kawo kawoydosona.

Hessa gisho, Iyoraami ba para gaareta ubbaara Xa7ira geetetiya bessa bis. Edoome asati iyanne iya para gaareta halaqata teqidosona; shin Iyoraami qamma dendidi, kessi ekidi bis. Iya olanchoti baqatidi, guye soo simmidosona.
He wodepe doomidi hachi gakanaw, Edoome asay Yihuda asaas haaretibookona. Libina asay qassi he wode makallis.
Iyoraami hanida harabaynne I oothidaba ubbay Yihuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Iyoraami hayqidi, ba mayzatan gahetis. Ba mayza Dawita Kataman moogetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Akaziyaasi kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Akaziyaasa
Akaaba na7ay, Isra7eele kawoy Iyoraami kawotida tammanne nam7antho laythan, Yihuda kawa, Iyoraama na7ay Akaziyaasi Yihudan kawotis.
Akaziyaasi kawotida wode, iyaw laythi laatamanne nam7a; I Yerusalaamen issi laythi kawotis. Iya aaye sunthay Gotolo; iya Isra7eele kawa Omira na7aa na7iw.
I entaw bollo gidida gisho, Akaaba soo asa ogiyan hemetis; Akaaba soo asay oothidaysada, I Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
Akaziyaasi Araame kawa Azaheelara Galadan de7iya Raamota kataman oletanaw bidi, Akaaba na7aa Iyoraamara issife bin, Araame asati Iyoraama caddidosona.

Iyoraami Araame kawa Azaheelara oletiya wode, Araame asati caddida cachafe paxanaw Izra7eele simmis. Iyoraama na7ay, Yihuda kawoy Akaziyaasi, cadetida Akaaba na7aa Iyoraama oychanaw duge Izra7eele bis.
